summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K on June 9, 2026, announcing a $50 million share repurchase program. The company may repurchase ordinary shares until December 31, 2026, through Morgan Stanley & Co. International PLC in open-market transactions, as approved by shareholders on April 28, 2026. The program is part of a broader $150 million repurchase capacity gained from a March 2026 Gilead transaction. Bought shares will be held as treasury. The objective is delivering shareholder value, mirroring a US open-market buyback. Watch for execution pace and potential suspension; no premium or tender mechanics apply.
